estimates.assumptions: Broad beans (fava beans) here are dry weight; 1 cup dry fava beans weighs ~250 g, so 3 cups = 750 g. Standard dry fava bean calorie density used as the recipe starts with soaking dried beans.
6 spring onions (scallions) average 15 g each after trimming; supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
4 garlic cloves average 3 g each (small-medium); supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
2 tsp cumin seeds/powder ≈ 4 g; supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
'Sprinkling' for coating is a modest 10 g total flour across all patties; supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.

Oil is 'as required' for deep frying (at least 1½ inches in a pan); absorption is typically 10-20 g per patty but total absorbed amount cannot be reliably estimated from the recipe text without batch size or post-fry data, so grams left null. Supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
